It validates JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) before allowing access to agents or gateways. The authorizer is Identity Provider (IdP) agnostic and works with any OAuth 2.0 compatible identity provider. You can configure the authorizer based on your IdP and allowed authorization scopes or claims.\\n\\n## Configure an Inbound Authorizer\\n\\nYou can configure your agent runtime (see CreateAgentRuntime ) or gateway (see CreateGateway ) to accept JWT bearer tokens by providing an authorizer configuration during agent or gateway creation.
